title: Estimating the tail of the singular product for the Hardy Littlewood and Bateman Horn conjectures
summary: This paper investigates the asymptotic behavior of the tail of the singular product arising in the Hardy Littlewood and Bateman Horn conjectures for one dimensional systems of polynomials. A universal estimate is proved, showing that the contribution of large primes decays like the reciprocal of the logarithm, regardless of the structure of the system. For linear systems (trivial Galois group) superfast convergence is obtained.
